title: US seizes domains of Chinese botnet used to hack NASA, Justice Department, and the Senate
content: The FBI has seized domains associated with a botnet that allowed Chinese-backed hackers to breach several U.S. government departments.

title: Apple is holding its iPhone launch event on September 9
content: The event is expected to be a notable one, as Apple is rumored to unveil its long-awaited foldable iPhone. It'll also be the first Apple event with John Ternus as CEO, who is scheduled to take the reins of the tech giant from Tim Cook on September 1.

title: Meta agrees to sweeping changes to restrict kids’ access to its apps as part of settlement with states
content: One of the most notable changes is that Meta plans to implement a daily two-hour time limit for teens that can only be disabled with parental permission.

title: Radar makes podcasts searchable — and usable by AI agents
content: Particle’s new podcast intelligence platform transcribes and analyzes more than 130,000 podcasts, making their conversations searchable on the web and accessible to AI agents through an API and MCP.

content: Perceptron offers an AI model that it says can help machines navigate the world while also providing in-depth visual intelligence.

content: Volvo is updating three of its electric vehicles with new hazard alerts to warn drivers when there are animals or vulnerable road users ahead.
